description: This file defines the Controller class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It includes class declarations, nested classes, and interface implementations related to plugin control, web interface, JSON-RPC, subsystem notifications, and configuration management. The file primarily contains class declarations, member functions, and interface mappings for plugin control and system management.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main plugin controller class implementing multiple interfaces for plugin management, web interface, JSON-RPC, subsystem notifications, and configuration. Contains nested classes for subsystem data, notification sink, and configuration handling. Manages plugin lifecycle, system notifications, and web requests.

classes.name: SubsystemsData
classes.description: JSON container class representing subsystem data with fields for subsystem type and active status.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Notification handler class for plugin and subsystem notifications, dispatching subsystem updates and state changes.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class holding probe settings, resume list, subsystem list, and UI flag.

classes.name: ProbeConfig
classes.description: Nested class within Config for probe-specific settings like TTL and node address.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, setting up necessary resources.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is unloaded.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests, deserializing request data.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles delete requests for plugin resources.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts device discovery with specified TTL.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates a plugin with a timeout.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates incoming request tokens and methods.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method call with parameters.
